summary.business_type: Content/Affiliate - Indoor Plants & Air Quality Guide

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt correctly configured with sitemap reference
Sitemap generated and valid with 29 URLs

findings.title: Missing canonical URLs
findings.description: No rel=canonical tag found in any page head.
findings.recommendation: Add rel=canonical to Layout.astro.

findings.title: Sitemap missing lastmod/priority
findings.description: Sitemap entries lack lastmod timestamps and priority values.
findings.recommendation: Configure @astrojs/sitemap with lastmod and priority options.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: Standard security headers not set.
findings.recommendation: Configure web server or CDN to add security headers.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique meta descriptions on all pages
Proper H1 tag on every page

findings.title: Double site-name in blog post title
findings.description: how-many-plants-per-room has doubled site name suffix.
findings.recommendation: Remove site-name from blog post title props.

findings.title: Missing OG image tags
findings.description: No og:image or twitter:image.
findings.recommendation: Add og:image to Layout.astro with default social preview image.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy violation
findings.description: Homepage jumps from H1 to H3, skipping H2.
findings.recommendation: Change RecommendationTool heading from H3 to H2.

findings.title: Homepage H1 broken with br tag
findings.description: H1 split by br tag.
findings.recommendation: Use CSS max-width instead of br tag in H1.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Plant pages include scientific names and care guides

findings.title: Blog posts are thin (400-600 words)
findings.description: 4 blog posts are 400-600 words each.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 1500-2500+ words with comprehensive coverage.

findings.title: No author credentials
findings.description: About page brief, lacks author bios/credentials.
findings.recommendation: Add author bio with credentials, cite peer-reviewed sources.

findings.title: No privacy policy
findings.description: Missing privacy policy page.
findings.recommendation: Add privacy policy and terms pages.

findings.title: Templated plant page content
findings.description: All 15 plant pages use same template structure.
findings.recommendation: Add unique content beyond data values to each plant page.

findings.title: Wrong homepage schema type
findings.description: Homepage uses Article instead of CollectionPage.
findings.recommendation: Change homepage schema to CollectionPage with ItemList.

findings.title: No plant page schema
findings.description: Individual plant pages have no JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add schema to each plant page.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Visual breadcrumbs lack structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to pages with breadcrumbs.

findings.title: Google Fonts without font-display:swap
findings.description: FOIT risk from external font loading.
findings.recommendation: Add display=swap to Google Fonts URL or self-host.

findings.title: External font requests render-blocking
findings.description: fonts.googleapis.com external dependency.
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts for better performance.

findings.title: No real plant images
findings.description: All 15 plant pages use emoji placeholders instead of photos.
findings.recommendation: Add high-quality plant photographs, optimize to WebP.

findings.title: Missing OG image
findings.description: No social share preview image.
findings.recommendation: Create 1200x630px branded social image.

findings.title: Missing llms.txt
findings.description: No llms.txt file at site root.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt listing key pages.

findings.title: No llms-full.txt
findings.description: No expanded content for AI training.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms-full.txt with full-text content.

findings.title: Lacks citation signals
findings.description: No links to original NASA research sources.
findings.recommendation: Add external citations with links to peer-reviewed research.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add real plant images for all 15 plants
Add OG image and social sharing meta tags
